name: Oh My Android
description: Local stdio MCP server shipped inside a native macOS app (macOS 26+, Apple silicon) that lets coding agents see and drive the Android Emulator and adb-connected phones: dp-scaled screenshots, compact UI tree, taps and typing, logcat, read-only SharedPreferences and SQLite, and dark mode, font scale, locale/RTL and TalkBack switches. No API key or account.
